key_entities: LLM-Review: BLOCK — finding (merge-change, N integrated commit(s))
propositions: A contributor comment containing the token 'recheck-review' must re-trigger a forced re-review of the current patchset, reset the retry budget, and post a success reply only if the bot's current-revision LLM-Review -1 tag is not a real finding.

The tag eligibility parser must classify all three production tag shapes: _TAG_SUFFIXES members, the hardcoded merge-review literal, and any tag with in-bracket (merge-change, N) suffix; unparseable or absent tags are treated as eligible (fail-open).

A recheck-review comment on a current-revision tag of 'LLM-Review: BLOCK — finding' (both bare and merge-change forms) must refuse with a refusal reply, emit RETRIGGER_REFUSED, and perform no enqueue or budget reset.
The Gerrit REST reply path must post a message body with no 'labels' key to avoid displacing label state.
Comments authored by the bot itself and comments lacking the recheck-review token must be silent no-ops; /rerun operator path must reset attempts budget before enqueueing.
